name: Mutual Corruption
source:
You’ve reincarnated into another world, where are the females are amazons and all the males are femboys. Women have the sex drivers as males from your old world, but males here have no will to fuck and are extremely toxic. The gender imbalance is on the verge of collapse, and society is slowly adopting extreme measures as the male population plumets. But you don’t know any of this, to your adopted family,  your something new, something uncorrupted by society, something they can mold. But they don’t know you, your not a sheep to the slaughter, but not quite a wolf. They will corrupt you, and you will corrupt them. They don’t know yet, that you can give as hard as you can take….eventually….
Can you save this world?
